IC2.IC2.1: Chronic Heart failure subjects with medical history of cardiac disease

IC.IC3: Left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) less than or equal to (=<) 40 percent (%).
IC.IC4: New York Heart Association (NYHA) class of II - IV
IC.IC5: NYHA II : Slight limitation of physical activity. Comfortable at rest, but ordinary physical activity results in undue breathlessness, fatigue or palpitation.
IC.IC6: NYHA III:Marked limitation of physical activity. Comfortable at rest, but less than ordinary activity causes undue breathlessness, fatigue or palpitation.
IC.IC7: NYHA IV:Unable to carry on any physical activity without discomfort. Symptoms at rest can be present. If any physical activity is undertaken, discomfort increased.
